description: Demolition of existing building and redevelopment of the site comprising the erection of a 14-storey (plus basement) building to provide purpose built student accommodation, comprising of 291 student bedrooms; associated communal facilities, roof terrace, cycle parking, refuse storage and landscaping.
decision_conditions:
The visual impact of the proposed building would affect heritage assets of Hammersmith Bridge and Castelnau Conservation Area and would detract from riverside views generally. 

Relevant views from Richmond are: Part 5 of TVIA: 14,15,16,19,20.

Officers note that views 14,15,16,19,20 are affected by the proposals (map Part 5 of the TVIA). In relation to these views the following are of concern:

Part 10 & 12

Part 10:
14: from Hammersmith Bridge on Richmond side: blocks most of the view to the distinctive church pinnacles which enhance the view at present;
15: from eastern side of Bridge: blocking view to pinnacles;
16: Hammersmith Bridge looking north: intrusive- blocks view to church, taller than neighbours, facing material appears to create additional emphasis.
 
Part 12:
19: Towpath view to pinnacles of St Paul’s Church- very distinctive view- visually impacted by proposal looming over it- the consented Landmark House would also be damaging;
20: Front of boathouse: also unfortunate- takes prominence away from church pinnacles.
 
Local Views SPD in particular relevant views are:
I3.1: Hammersmith bridge from Castelnau;
I3.2: Hammersmith Bridge from Barnes Riverside.

Conclusion: the proposals would clearly be harmful in views from Hammersmith Bridge area and the riverside. The proposed building at the height shown would be visually harmful, and dominate and detract from noted views, and detract from the significance of heritage assets of Hammersmith Bridge and Castelnau Conservation Area. Facing material for a tall building does not seem visually recessive enough.
